organization.name: SEETA with libp2p (LeakDetectAI)
organization.summary: The proposal names SEETA as recipient, with the project hosted on a libp2p community page. The SEC4AI-AI4SEC GitHub organization holds the research repositories listed in the proposal. The libp2p project page lists Manu Sheel Gupta as project lead and Dr. Pritha Gupta as research lead.

previousFunding.label: TheDAO Security Fund Round 1 record: Leak Detect: Protecting Ethereum from Hidden Leakages

delivery.grant: TheDAO Security Fund Round 1 (Ethereum Security Quadratic Funding): Leak Detect: Protecting Ethereum from Hidden Leakages
delivery.promised: Per the Round 1 project description and the team's announcement: hidden information leakage detection, wallet safety analysis and tooling for AI agents interacting with Web3 systems. The Round 1 record lists no specific deliverables.

claims.claim: Public research repositories exist: autosca-hw-wallet-tester, deep-learning-sca and AutoMLQuantILDetect.
claims.method: GitHub API: all three are public Apache-2.0 repositories. Created 2026-05-06 (hw-wallet-tester), 2022-08-26 (deep-learning-sca) and 2024-06-17 (AutoMLQuantILDetect). Last pushes 2026-07-06, 2026-06-07 and 2026-09-04. Stars 1, 3 and 5. Code behavior was not run.

claims.claim: The research direction is documented in the ACM AISec paper Automated Detection of Side Channels in Cryptographic Protocols (DROWN the ROBOTs).
claims.method: Crossref lists the paper in the Proceedings of the 14th ACM Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Security (2021-11-15). Authors include Pritha Gupta, Eyke Hullermeier and Juraj Somorovsky.

claims.claim: AutoSCA was developed in the context of Achelos.
claims.method: The GitHub API returned 404 for achelos/AutoSCA, so the linked repository was not found. The Achelos relationship was not confirmed by a public source.

claims.claim: LeakDetectAI was selected for the Ethereum Security Quadratic Funding round with support from Giveth and TheDAO Security Fund.
claims.method: The Round 1 record exists on thedao.fund transparency pages and the team discussion dated 2026-05-12 announces the selection. Round 1 amounts are not recorded here.

claims.claim: Manu Gupta is a Technical Lead and Maintainer in the libp2p ecosystem with 20 or more years of open-source experience.
claims.method: The GitHub profile (created 2013-07-06) lists Libp2p among its affiliations. Maintainer role and years of experience were not confirmed in a source.

claims.claim: Existing hardware-wallet testing has found vulnerabilities in Ethereum wallets.
claims.method: The proposal does not claim a specific finding. No public vulnerability report from this work was found.
